rule_outs: Dwelling 3 m from the best section
summary: Short kerb under an apartment block, 3 m from the building.

drivers.seclusion: Apartment block 3 m from the kerb along the whole stretch; kindergarten 12 m away.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow lane with a few cars squeezed along it; ground beside the lane is kerb and rail fence only.
drivers.traffic: Lane beside a four-track rail corridor; train noise.
drivers.convention: A few cars park along the kerb but the stretch is too short for a van to blend in.

flags: Steep: 10.6% mean grade by the DEM, though readings jitter
sun_shade: Building shades the kerb for most of the day; rail side open.

best_section.where: Railway Avenue, beside the Scribe on Clarence apartments
